center.rootGoal: Increase the human Center-holder's sovereign capacity by cultivating low-maintenance economic Fruit whose accumulated money, knowledge, infrastructure, and distribution lower the cost of producing subsequent Fruit.
center.direction: Discover, cheaply falsify, and cultivate machine-mediated internet assets that can acquire, fulfill, and monetize with minimal continuing human labor.
invariants: No epistemic promotion without accountable evidence.
The organism exists to nourish the human Center-holder; the human does not exist to nourish the organism.
Prefer passive discoverability and automatic fulfillment.
Kill weak branches cheaply before building.
No debt, hidden obligations, human impersonation, or unauthorized public exposure.

soil.principle: Prefer problems a dominant upstream product is structurally unlikely to solve because the resolution sits outside its core job.
Reject candidates whose resolution collapses to a trivial filter unless another moat such as distribution makes trivial implementation irrelevant.
A Fruit for this Garden should attach to an existing nutrient channel where buyers or machines already search; repeated human outreach is a passivity failure.

Economic reproduction occurs only when later Fruit inherit money, knowledge, infrastructure, code, distribution, or market evidence that lowers the human/capital/uncertainty cost of the next generation.

opportunities.name: Google Maps Business → Website Identity Guard
opportunities.thesis: A correct Google Maps business entity can contain a stale, wrong, parent, or unrelated website pointer; downstream contact enrichment can then work perfectly on the wrong entity.
opportunities.moneyFlow: Google Maps scraping and contact enrichment workflows
opportunities.nutrientChannel: Apify / API workflows using Google Maps data
opportunities.passivity: Potentially high if metered machine-to-machine verification
opportunities.reproductivePotential: Could branch into website/contact attribution trust adapters
